mapper.select: SELECT id, keyword, search_count, hot_value FROM hot_search WHERE keyword LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND status = 1 ORDER BY hot_value DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: INSERT INTO hot_search (keyword, search_count, hot_value, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{keyword}, #{increment}, #{increment}, 1, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE search_count = search_count + #{increment}, hot_value = hot_value + #{increment}, update_time = NOW()
